patterns.title_ru: Насколько многое изменилось бы, если команде нужен ещё день для решения?

langs.formula: How much would change if [the team needs another day to decide]?

examples.text: **How much would change if the client asked for more detail?**

examples.text: **How much would change if the meeting was moved?**

examples.text: **How much would change if the colleagues prefer remote participation?**
